newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE wheat down on old crop supplies, CBOT, stg.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE wheat down on old crop supplies, CBOT, stg.

text.p: LIFFE wheat fell in moderate volume, with old crop hit by abundant supplies, new crop by US markets and both affected by a strong sterling.
Total volume was an unexciting 435 lots, an improvement on Tuesday's 21.
July had the biggest fall, last trading 2.20 stg lower at 87.50 stg. July volume was 59 lots.
But November was most active, with 149 lots done. It last traded 0.60 stg lower at 93.00 stg.
"There's still grain coming out and we've got 100,000 tonnes in store," one trader said, to explain the old crop fall. He also cited some liquidation by merchants as a factor.
The new crop followed Chicago lower, helped by some shipper sales, he said.
On Tuesday, CBOT soft red winter wheat futures closed lower on rain over the weekend in the U.S. Great Plains hard red winter wheat region, traders said.
LIFFE barley also fell, with January most active on 10 of a total 14 lots. It last traded 0.10 stg lower at 92.50 stg.
